author: jessica
source: his 2026-10-15 06:22: "Back to city: You find a slafe which tells you of a object to be recovered and returned to a major city/settlement. Placing talking NPC in city"; 06:23 "it like closes the loop of an adventure so you end up back at base"
_note: BACK TO CITY, a new family: a slate sends you out, you take something small back off whoever holds it in a
dangerous place, and you carry it home to a MAJOR SETTLEMENT and hand it over in a conversation. The adventure
goes out and the ending comes back to base. His idea; words Jessica's.
11a's shape (recover off the dungeon boss, talk hand-back at stage 100), which he called the best yet, so the ONE
new mechanic here is the city (his rule: prove a verb, then vary it cheaply). Everything else is proven.
UNBUILT, so the lint should refuse exactly this half (ELIZA'S):
1. place.second.settlement: a FIXED named settlement as a place, not a pooled POI. Akila City first.
2. The person spawned inside that city at a spot of the build's choosing, and not colliding with vanilla's people.
Where in Akila is his eye: the market is the obvious spot for a trader.
No 'deal' yet: started by hand until the city place exists, then it joins the local-cargo slate pool like 11a.
Pay: reward on the talk, the single ending. 'hard' is a placeholder, as on 11a; the tier is his.
His voice on the radio first and the same voice in person, which is the first of 11a's three reasons (his).

place._theme: A dungeon out there; Akila City at home. The city is named, not drawn from a pool, so there is no theme to filter.

prose.name: Recovery: Trader's Strongbox on <Planet>
prose.briefing: Spacers hit a trader's supply run and took the whole hold to the <Place>. He only wants one thing back: a strongbox with his trading papers in it. He's at his stall in <SecondPlace>.

beats.objective: Recover the trader's strongbox from the <Place>
beats.journal: The spacers at the <Place> had the trader's strongbox. I took it back. He's waiting at his stall in <SecondPlace>.

beats.objective: Return the strongbox to the trader in <SecondPlace>
beats.journal: Spacers took a trader's hold to the <Place>. I went in and brought his strongbox back to <SecondPlace>. Without the papers in it he couldn't trade.
beats.greeting: Tell me that's what I think it is.

exchanges.reply: That's it, dent in the lid and all. Everything I need to trade is in there. I'd have lost a month getting it again. Thank you.
Papers, mostly. My permit, my stall number, two years of receipts. Nobody would steal it on purpose. They took the whole hold, and it was in the hold.

exchanges.prompt: Why not go after it yourself?
exchanges.reply: I haul crates and sell them. I don't go into places like that, and I'd like to keep it that way. Back here, people know me.

exchanges.prompt: Which lane did they jump you on?
exchanges.reply: The slow one. You've run it too, then. You'll know they never jump you on the fast lane. Not enough time to plan it.

beats._talk: Exchange 0 is the hand-back: it ends the talk, takes the Trader's Strongbox and sets stage 100, which pays 'reward'. Exchange 3 is a [Long Hauler] line (his 2026-10-14 RP feature): only a hauler would ask which lane. Voiced lines: no names, no places, no factions, no currency.

broadcast: They hit my run and took the lot. Keep the cargo. There's a strongbox in there with my papers, and without them I can't sell a thing. I'd like that back.
_speech: His own voice on the radio, then in person. Voice is 04a's (dgkKQcJqyy5AP0dqleUU), used once so far, chosen so this is not Isla again (four Delves already); his ear decides. No names, no places, no currency.
